_about: Public-domain Nicholas Love (died about 1424, prior of the Charterhouse of Mount Grace) for the Word Hoard: The Mirrour of the Blessed Lyf of Jesu Christ, his Middle English translation of the Meditationes Vitae Christi made before 1410, edited by Lawrence F. Powell (Oxford: Clarendon Press, 1908), from an Internet Archive scan. Added 2026-10-17 by lane A, round 27 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

love-mirrour-powell: The Mirrour of the Blessed Lyf of Jesu Christ, a translation of the Meditationes Vitae Christi made before 1410 by Nicholas Love, ed. Lawrence F. Powell (Oxford: Clarendon Press, MCMVIII)

_alternates.love-copies: Four other copies of the 1908 edition
